title: Root saturation through the finite torsion quotient
statement:
Let $G$ be an abelian group generated as a group by a finite list $p_1,\ldots,p_r$, allowing $r=0$, and let $P=\{\sum_{i=1}^r n_i p_i:n_i\in\mathbf N\}\subseteq G$. Put $T=\{g\in G:\exists n\in\mathbf Z_{\ge1},\ ng=0\}$, the torsion subgroup, and let $\pi:G\to L=G/T$ be the quotient homomorphism. Then $T$ is finite and $L$ is free abelian of finite rank, meaning that $L$ has a finite $\mathbf Z$-basis [def-weil-pbc-free-module], for the canonical action of $\mathbf Z$ by integer multiples. In particular $\ell\mapsto\ell\otimes1$ embeds $L$ in $L\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q$. With this identification, set
$$C=\left\{\sum_{i=1}^r q_i\pi(p_i):q_i\in\mathbf Q_{\ge0}\right\}\subseteq L\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q.$$
For every $g\in G$ one has
$$\bigl(\exists n\in\mathbf Z_{\ge1},\ ng\in P\bigr)\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\pi(g)\in C.$$
No torsion-freeness assumption on $G$ is imposed.

proof.text: The finite generating list gives AddGroup.FG G and Module.Finite ℤ G. The torsion subgroup, regarded as its integral submodule, is finitely generated because ℤ is noetherian. Its elements have finite additive order, so it is finite by Module.finite_of_fg_torsion (Mathlib.GroupTheory.FiniteAbelian.Basic), the torsion specialization of the PID structure theorem [lem-sbc-finitely-generated-abelian-group-structure]. The quotient L = G/T is finitely generated and torsion-free (Mathlib QuotientAddGroup.fg and QuotientAddGroup.instIsAddTorsionFree). Apply Module.basisOfFiniteTypeTorsionFree' [lem-trf-fg-torsionfree-group-free] to L over ℤ to obtain a basis b indexed by Fin s [def-weil-pbc-free-module].

source.place: Tag 0FJ8 (example-K0-PID), structure theorem; explicit torsion and quotient computation by Q87 using the cited Mathlib structure theorem.

proof.text: For every coordinate i of b, apply the tensor linear map TensorProduct.lid ℤ ℚ after TensorProduct.map (b.coord i) id. By bilinearity [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], it sends l ⊗ 1 to the rational cast of the integer b.repr l i. Equality of two canonical tensors therefore gives equality of every integer coordinate, since ℤ → ℚ is injective. Injectivity of b.repr gives equality in L. This proof also works when the basis is empty; no full tensor coordinate isomorphism is needed.

source.place: Tag 00CX (lemma-tensor-product), universal property; explicit finite-coordinate calculation by Q87.

proof.text: Use tensor symmetry to work in V = ℚ ⊗[ℤ] L with its rational scalar action. Let f:G→V send g to 1 ⊗ π(g); its kernel is exactly T by step 2 and the quotient kernel criterion. If ng = ∑ m_i p_i with n > 0, applying f gives n f(g) = ∑ m_i f(p_i). Multiply by 1/n to get f(g) = ∑ (m_i/n) f(p_i), with all coefficients nonnegative. Tensor symmetry and bilinearity [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] turn this back into the stated tensors π(p_i) ⊗ (m_i/n).

proof.text: For q_i ≥ 0 take D = ∏ q_i.den > 0, with empty product 1. For each i, q_i.den divides D, say D = q_i.den * c_i. Nonnegativity gives q_i.num ≥ 0, so m_i = c_i * q_i.num.toNat is a natural number and D q_i = m_i by Rat.den_mul_eq_num. Multiplying the rational cone identity by D gives f(Dg - ∑ m_i p_i) = 0 by bilinearity [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. The kernel calculation from step 3 puts t = Dg - ∑ m_i p_i in T. Choose k > 0 with kt = 0 from the definition of torsion. Distributing k over the difference and finite sum gives (kD)g = ∑ (k m_i)p_i, with kD > 0. Empty sums cause no exception.

lean.statement: theorem root_saturation_torsion_cone {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G] (r : ℕ) (p : Fin r → G) (hp : AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range p) = ⊤) : Finite (torsion G) ∧ (∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin s) ℤ (G ⧸ torsion G))) ∧ Function.Injective (fun l : G ⧸ torsion G ↦ l ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : ℚ)) ∧ ∀ g : G, (∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ m : Fin r → ℕ, n • g = ∑ i, m i • p i) ↔ ∃ q : Fin r → ℚ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) ∧ (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (torsion G) g) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : ℚ) = ∑ i, (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (torsion G) (p i)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] q i

reviewed_lean.note: Statement matches node clause by clause: AddCommGroup G with any universe; finite list Fin r → G that may be empty and generates G as a group (AddSubgroup.closure = ⊤); P written as ℕ-combinations; T = AddCommGroup.torsion; π = QuotientAddGroup.mk'; Finite T; basis of G⧸T indexed by Fin s; l ↦ l⊗1 into ⊗ℚ is injective; root-saturation ↔ non-negative rational cone in (G⧸T)⊗ℚ, with π(p i)⊗q i = q i•(π(p i)⊗1). No torsion-free or extra assumptions. Edge cases r=0, finite G, ℤ, ℤ⊕ℤ/2 checked. Node identical to side-live apart from lean; lean.statement verbatim in file; no defs, proof sorry only, docstrings give source place + blueprint id + 4-step proof; report has Worker report and Second reading by Q82 sections. No duplicate in Mathlib or project (FineMonoidFiniteSaturation is the parent; rational-cone-simultaneous-lifts needs injective i). Not recompiled, no file changed.
